mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_alarm_log (variable_name, floor_code, room_canonical, suite_norm, metric_kind, alarm_band, current_value, limit_value, sent_at) VALUES (#{variableName}, #{floorCode}, #{roomCanonical}, #{suiteNorm}, #{metricKind}, #{alarmBand}, #{currentValue}, #{limitValue}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM telemetry_alarm_log WHERE variable_name = #{variableName} AND alarm_band = #{alarmBand} ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 1
